description: Menu — the floating panel. bg-floating + elevation-low (in dark mode the panel rises a ladder step instead of casting a shadow — the flashlight principle), rounded, with the BLEED GUARD: the block ends pad by the panel's own radius (same token) so full-bleed item fills never clip the corners; the sides stay unpadded — items run edge to edge. The items area is a true SLOT seeded with three Menu-items: designers add as many as they want. Positioning the panel is the consumer's job (popover + CSS anchor positioning). Also the collapsed sidebar's floating submenu.
notes: The three item parts are demo content — designers duplicate or hide items inside instances; developers place any number of eds-menu-item buttons. The first bg-floating consumer: dark mode gets the elevated surface for free. v0.2.0 (2026-09-05, Victor's sidebar review): the BLEED GUARD — the panel pads its block ends by ITS OWN RADIUS (same token, 4px), sides unpadded, so full-bleed item fills can never clip the rounded corners. The three hard-coded items became a true SLOT (Slots GA'd June 2026), seeded with three Menu-items: designers add as many as they want. This panel is also the collapsed sidebar's floating submenu — composition. v0.3.0 (2026-09-05): layout.align removed — column children stretch by default, so items span the panel's full width without consumer styling.
